question: Should this newer dual-surface branch become the canonical Neuralwatt implementation instead of https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/1760?
rationale: Both PRs implement the same provider, while this branch carries newer hardening and is mergeable but still needs presentation fixes and contributor proof; choosing the permanent landing branch is a maintainer ownership decision.

options.title: Adopt this branch
options.body: Treat this PR as canonical, require the three presentation repairs and exact-head live proof, then retire the predecessor branch.

options.title: Continue the predecessor
options.body: Keep https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/1760 canonical and port any unique dual-surface, testing, and integration improvements from this branch before landing it.

recommendation.title: Adopt this branch
recommendation.body: Treat this PR as canonical, require the three presentation repairs and exact-head live proof, then retire the predecessor branch.

likelyOwner.reason: They performed most Neuralwatt hardening and repeated integration work across the relevant branches.
